description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the Rates of Exchange effective from 23.07.2018 to 29.07.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs procedures.
